meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Runs maximum-saturation research with a cooperating team, claim-graph gating, and a cited, QA'd deliverable. Use when the user explicitly asks for research or a deep investigation, including any 'ulw' research wording.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 组织协作团队跑多轮调研,产出带引用、经质检的研究报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你需要一份结论有据可查、经得起追问的深度调研报告。
copy.tagline_en: Run multi-round team research and get a cited, QA-checked report
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a deep research report where every claim is cited and verified.

howto.what: 当你明确要求研究或深度调查(含 ulw 字样)时,Claude 进入 ULW-RESEARCH 模式:自行拆分研究轴、组建协作团队分头搜集、追查线索、用辩论互相质疑、跑代码验证争议结论,最后给出每条都带引用或验证证据的报告。
howto.when: 当你明确说出 “ulw-research”、“ultradebate” 等 ulw 研究字样,或明确要求做研究、深度调查时触发;普通提问和调试不会触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-research 深挖这个话题,先问我要哪种交付格式
say.note: 团队创建前会先提格式方案并等你确认

say.text: 对这份报告里有争议的结论跑代码验证一下
say.note: 验证脚本会作为证据记录

say.text: 汇报这次研究用了多少来源、花了多少分钟
say.note: 交付消息带来源总数与用时

howto.what_en: Explicitly ask for research or deep investigation (any 'ulw' wording counts): Claude enters ULW-RESEARCH mode, splits the topic into axes, runs a team that chases leads and debates claims, code-verifies them, and delivers a cited synthesis.
howto.when_en: Triggers only when you explicitly ask for it: 'ulw-research', 'ultradebate' or other 'ulw' research wording, or an explicit request for research or deep investigation.

say_en.text: Use ulw-research to dig into this topic; ask me which format I want first
say_en.note: A format-proposal gate runs before the team is created.

say_en.text: Run code verification on the contested claims in this report
Report how many sources and how many minutes this research took
say_en.note: The closing briefing carries source totals and run time.
